note: Plan-only prompts on a fresh claude-opus-5-5 subagent; control without the skill. Grade from the answer text. Baseline 2026-10-11 (claude-opus-5-5): control already passed both prompts (gh run watch, pgrep -fx, timeout-bounded loops). The skill adds the background-wait and check-state rules; the self-matching pgrep loop is lived evidence from a real session, not reproduced here. Against the assertions: the control passes pgrep-wait (it used --commit and timeout on every wait) but fails registry-poll (`timeout 20m ... || echo "timed out"` exits 0 and drops the last value). Only registry-poll separates control and skill; the rest of the skill rests on the real-session pgrep incident and the check-state rule.

evals.prompt: I just pushed branch feat/x and started `bun run build` in the background in another shell. Wait until the CI run for the push finishes and until that build process ends, then tell me the results. Give the exact shell commands you would run; do not run them.
evals.expected_output: gh run watch <id> --exit-status or gh pr checks --watch; process wait by PID (kill -0) or a bracketed pgrep pattern; no `while pgrep -f "bun run build"` that matches its own shell; every loop bounded
assertions: the CI run is matched to the pushed commit SHA (e.g. `--commit`), not `--limit 1` on the branch
every watch command and PID loop has an explicit deadline
evals.with_skill_result: 2026-10-11 claude-opus-5-5 with the skill: pass on all assertions. pgrep-wait: run found by `--commit` and workflow with a bounded wait, `timeout 60m gh run watch`, PID from `pgrep -f '[b]un run build'` waited with `timeout 30m` around a kill -0 loop, both in the background with logs. registry-poll: kept `last`, exited 1 on timeout. Compared with the control, only registry-poll differs.

evals.prompt: The release workflow passed. Wait until mycli@1.4.0 shows up on npm as latest. Exact commands only.
evals.expected_output: poll npm view with a fixed number of tries and a timeout report; no unbounded until-loop
assertions: the poll keeps the last value and exits non-zero on timeout
evals.with_skill_result: 2026-10-11 claude-opus-5-5 with the skill: pass on all assertions. pgrep-wait: run found by `--commit` and workflow with a bounded wait, `timeout 60m gh run watch`, PID from `pgrep -f '[b]un run build'` waited with `timeout 30m` around a kill -0 loop, both in the background with logs. registry-poll: kept `last`, exited 1 on timeout. Compared with the control, only registry-poll differs.

evals.prompt: 45 minutes ago you started a background subagent to open a PR for issue #12. Such tasks take about 15 minutes. No completion notice has arrived. What do you do now? Give exact commands; do not run them.
evals.expected_output: stops waiting for the notice; reads the agent's last assistant messages from its transcript (Claude Code subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl, jq on assistant text); checks the real result (gh pr list/view for the PR); reports done, working or failed from what it saw
assertions: reads the agent transcript instead of only waiting or re-dispatching
checks runtime status and the last transcript entry before naming the agent failed or working
evals.source: three agents in one session finished without a completion notice; the user once waited about 40 minutes
baseline_failures: control (with the current skill) checked the PR, branch and processes and asked the agent via a message, but never read the agent's transcript file
evals.with_skill_result: 2026-10-11 claude-opus-5-5: pass. Read the last assistant messages from subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl with jq, checked the PR with gh pr list/view, and decided done / working / failed from what it saw.

evals.prompt: A background agent started 50 minutes ago; tasks like it take 20. Its transcript has not changed for 25 minutes, and its last entry is a Bash tool_use running `gh run watch 123 --exit-status` with no result yet. No PR exists. Is it failed? What do you check, exact commands?
evals.expected_output: does not call it failed from the static transcript; checks the runtime status and the run (gh run view 123) and reports it as waiting on that tool call, or stuck if the run finished long ago
assertions: not reported as failed only because the transcript is static
evals.with_skill_result: 2026-10-11 claude-opus-5-5: pass. Said it cannot be called failed from a static transcript; checked the task list, the gh run watch process, the last transcript entry (pending Bash tool_use) and `gh run view 123`; mapped to working / stuck / failed and said done is impossible without a PR.
